profile.headline: Software Developer, Marine Corps Veteran
profile.summary: I am a software developer with strong skills in C# and C/C++. I have worked on various game-related projects on the side and have professional experience as a software developer in the defense industry working on SIGINT collection/analysis applications. I have developed strong leadership skills through my experience in the US Marine Corps and 8 years of teaching martial arts and have led the software development effort of small teams on multiple projects. The areas of software development I am most interested in are artificial intelligence, scientific simulation, and game development.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Led software development effort of internal simulation tool that reduced time to develop customer facing SIGINT demonstrations from 2 weeks to 3 hours

Worked on high performance real-time data visualization displays in .Net and Qt/C++

Responsible for the authorship of comprehensive documentation, product description, and release notes for an internal simulation tool

Developed an accurate 2 month development plan including milestones, major releases, and task assignments

Conducted software developer and user training sessions

positions.title: Game Developer (Single Project Contractor)
positions.description:
Worked on an artistic 3d multiplayer virtual environment in Unity3d

Implemented automated build/deployment tools that would build the project for multiple platforms and restart the running server using the newest version

Created tools for coworkers to debug and monitor server state and load

Developed AI for more than a dozen different creatures simulating predator-prey dynamics and hunting tactics

Optimized networking solutions to support over 5000 networked objects in the world for up to a dozen simultaneous users

Coordinated with developers, artists, and producers to manage scope and focus development resources

positions.title: Head Instructor
positions.description:
Taught classes of 5-20 students including classes of toddlers and classes of adults

    Managed the operation of a 100 student school with the assistance of a single co-worker

    Oversaw the examination of students and the development of a structured curriculum

    Tailored lesson plans to the specific needs of individual students, including working with special needs and disabled students

    Worked with parents and prospective student’s to gauge their desires and recommend appropriate programs

    Maintained student records and performed billing operations

    Conducted life skill training throughout the month, incorporating the life skill in the school and discussed it’s application at home, in school, and in life

    Worked with parents and school teachers to develop a coordinated plan to correct inappropriate behavior

    Cross-trained in other martial arts in order to assist the student’s of other instructors from other schools within the company

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Trained children, teens, and adults in Kenpo Karate and Filipino Arnis. Assisted in developing the schools curriculum. Created a database of lesson plans, training ideas, and explanations of techniques. Collaborated with other instructors to adjust training in order to meet the needs of each student.

positions.title: Self-Defense Instructor
positions.description: Developed and instructed a self-defense curriculum for children age 5-13. Maintained detailed records of student information. Conducted evaluations of student performance.

positions.title: Infantry
positions.description:
Conducted daily patrol operations while deployed to Afghanistan.
Responsible for the maintenance and operation of one of the squads combat vehicles.
Received a Purple Heart for wounds received in combat.

projects.title: Ars Plastica
projects.description: Ars Plastica is a virtual art world/experience built within the Unity game engine. As the lead programmer, I developed AI for over a dozen creatures, optimized networking solutions to support 5000+ objects, and was responsible for the application build and deployment.

projects.title: EnviroGen
projects.description:
EnviroGen is a WIP environment generator written in C#/WPF that can quickly generate large 2d height maps. Currently, these environments are generated using noise algorithms such as Simplex Noise. The height maps can be modified with simple modifiers such as addition, scaling, or normalization, or physical processes such as erosion.

EnviroGen comes with an easy to use node based editor that allows you to quickly apply modifiers to an environment and see the results.

EnviroGen's goal is to produce whole simulated environments: terrain, oceans, weather, tectonics, vegetation, animals, and more. Currently, terrain can be generated and colored based on height. Two erosion processes (thermal and hydraulic) can be ran, but they are ran at generation time, not as an active simulation.
